title: Direct fractional-mask sampling through actual tile kernels and CSV readback

entry_inventory.meaning: Entry registration only; not full signatures/defaults/numerical compatibility

implementation: Sampling-only projection at all four actual emitters: standalone, minimum-distance training, Smile training, and runtime sampled validation. Estimate and compile the same freshly charged view, preserve original SampledFeatures identity.

Positive weights retain scientific values; zero weights become NoData under existing sample/dropNulls/sampleRegions rules. Mask magnitude neither scales values nor changes random sampling probability.

toFloat/toDouble and float/double aliases cast only science, retaining weight identity and prior Float32 stages. Added constants may use a direct carrier raw finite-grid template without exposing unmasked science.
Reject source-free raw bands even when mask/outer Image/addBands has raster lineage; require source facts to agree with actual compiled raster labels before merging.

Keep source/grid/time, original schema/IDs/geometries/order, local hash RNG and existing50000-work/500-node/native limits. Unsupported nested arithmetic/clip/unmask/integer/where carriers still reject.

Native tests skip only a genuinely absent ignored audit manifest on portable checkouts; invalid files/directories/broken symlinks fail. SDK/compiler parity stays runnable. No runtime dependency rebuild or installation.
Python69 and JS23 examples, web syntax reference, engineering instructions and architecture documents updated.

official_clients.scope: Official SDK serialization and local compiler graphs; no Google computation

native_tile_probe.execution_scope: Actual GeoTrellis Float32/Float64 tiles through LocalEeMaskWeightsNumeric.applyTile, then existing Image.sample and sampleRegions numeric tile kernels. No SparkContext, engine service, sandbox batch task, VM, container, private raster, or Google request.

physical_csv_readback.scope: Trusted synthetic tile/CSV orchestration; batch raster engine execution is not exercised

independent_review.scope: Scoped correctness/resource/ownership review, not full repository security audit; repeated sourcefree controls are not added as new unique coverage

failures_preserved: Node-bound assertion reproduced33 actual nodes versus32 estimated; possible implicit Float64 conversion now precharged in node and work estimates.

Four unchanged official SDK source-free raw constant counterexamples initially accepted by borrowing a raster mask grid; direct/mixed explicit sample ROI and sampleRegions now reject. A genuinely on_grid-bound constant remains accepted.
Forged trusted internal constant/cast arguments could carry unused Source lineage; actual compiled operand label must now match source facts. No normal SDK route to this forged IR was established.
A transient proposed unbounded cast-shape loop was rejected in static review and removed before final freeze; no actual hang is claimed.
New root harness assertions initially used wrong sampler header/type and incomplete Source constructor; corrected tests without changing the existing API.
limits_and_unverified: No automatic Google compute/auth/quota calls. Discuss remote comparison only for unusually complex behavior not reliably determined by local references and documentation.
Weighted science arithmetic/reductions/display alpha/raster weight export, spherical fractional clip and full global constant-grid semantics remain open; no fallback binary clip claim.
Local updateMask composition and seeded sampling RNG are explicit local policies, not verified Google equivalence.
Official Python literal GeoJSON serialization may omit Feature.id; declared source_id properties and raster source metadata are tested, missing wire identities are never fabricated.
No full Spark batch, service/browser/isolated script, private real-data or deployment acceptance. The CSV tests use native kernel rows with a trusted orchestration harness.

Existing Wave64 audit JAR is reused unchanged and not deployment eligible. Its245 runtime hashes are checked against that audit manifest, not newly authenticated to public upstream provenance; prior39 matches/7 mismatches/199 unlisted remain unresolved. This is not a vulnerability finding or a clean-security claim.
Selected malformed IR tests do not constitute a general schema validator for arbitrary forged internal IR. Existing S2/projection and other full compatibility gaps remain.
The full production-oriented goal remains active; this is a tested sampling consumer slice.
